description: Read-only public tool references and a device setup book for the user's AI; this service cannot operate devices.

setupBook.title: Device setup, phone selection and household hotspot engineering book

service_interface.scope: Previous service 1.2.0 public read-only book delivery and rejection tests; not evidence for the v2 rollout or target-device operation.

scope: Isolated Linux IPv4 loopback SOCKS application through Shadowsocks 2022 TCP to a TLS fixture, sing-box 1.14.4.
Wrong-port failure and a single-factor repair; disconnect failure and successful reconnection.
Observed route and server-side test DNS; process cleanup and unchanged host network.

mobile_hotspot.scope: Physical Android/iOS phone selection, Wi-Fi coexistence, hotspot/tethering, downstream DNS/IPv6/UDP, screen-off, thermal and reconnection acceptance. Executable procedures are specified; no hardware result is claimed.

capability_boundaries: This knowledge MCP is read-only; the user's authorized AI operates the actual target device.
The book grants no extra authorization. Respect the active task and required system permissions.
Credentials, subscription URLs, private device details and logs stay local to the target device.
Retrieval is not evidence that a device was configured. Validation metadata states its exact tested scope.
A phone VPN does not by itself prove tethered clients use that VPN; verify downstream traffic separately.
